messages:
Maya (CS): Quick note from today's LumenWave onboarding: three repeated asks — per-route cost visibility, ability to pin an embedding model per route, and a short onboarding checklist with starter prompts. They mentioned this could affect renewal if not addressed.

Devon (PM): Can you paste the exact lines they used and which routes? helps me triage.

Maya (CS): Quotes: 
- "We can't charge internal teams without per-endpoint numbers."
- "If embeddings spike we need a way to lock to a cheaper model per route."
- "A one-page checklist with sample prompts would have saved onboarding time."
They called out `summarize-inbox` and `kb-search` in multiple calls.

Lena (Product): Good capture. Prioritize checklist + prompts as ASAP (low effort). CSV export of per-route costs as a short-term stopgap. Full console per-route cost dashboard is roadmap work. Embedding-pin is medium effort but clear ROI.

Tom (Eng): For CSV export we need route_id in billing agg and a small authenticated endpoint to pull CSVs by account. Estimate: ~2 dev days. Embedding-pin looks like adding an override metadata field + resolve logic, ~3 dev days. UI/dashboard is multi-sprint.

Maya (CS): I'll collect verbatim clips and open a cs:feedback ticket. Recommend we mark LumenWave as at-risk if no interim CSV by 2026-04-12 (one week). Also please produce a short enablement one-pager for CSMs to set expectations.

Devon (PM): Action items: Maya opens ticket with quotes and example routes; Product drafts checklist; Eng scopes CSV and embed-pin API. I'll flag CSV as P0 quick-win.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-4932 created by Maya (CS) — "LumenWave onboarding: per-route cost CSV + embed-pin + checklist" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-4932

Tom (Eng): Adding CS-4932 to sprint buffer, will post PR and sample CSV here when ready.

Lena (Product): Drafting checklist now, will share for CS signoff.

Maya (CS): Thanks team, I'll update LumenWave with interim timeline and capture renewal risk.
